issue.title: Answer once, advance once: review-walk auto-advance
issue.description: During the `]s` morning review, every gesture that answers the row the walk just landed on moves to the next remaining review item in the same keystroke, and shows one toast that says what you did and where you are now. Today only Ctrl+Alt+F (and the PRE/POST Ctrl+Enter claim) does this. Alt+F stays the one explicit "stay" answer. `]s` stays the skip key. Ordinary daytime use of the same keys does not change.
